capabilities: Render Markdown outlines as interactive mindmaps with multiple trees per file
Edit mindmap nodes with keyboard shortcuts or toolbar buttons, keeping Markdown in sync
Toggle top-down and left-right layouts per tree via front-matter
Open internal note links and external URLs from selected nodes
Export the current mindmap as PNG or PDF next to the note
disambiguation: Not a link graph view; it renders one file's bullet-list outline as a mindmap, not connections between notes.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no way to view or edit a nested bullet list as an interactive mindmap without leaving the Markdown file.
summary: Renders Markdown outlines as interactive mindmaps with top-down and left-right layouts, node editing, and PNG/PDF export.
